summary: Diff adds a new PIXEL NOVA DIGITALS frontend with routing, themed UI, client-side image/video/voice generation utilities, and authenticated history via Internet Identity-backed backend methods. However, backend persistence across upgrades and proper timestamp handling are not evidenced, and several unrequested features (admin/access control initialization, profile setup, and external promotional footer link) were added.

missing_requirements.requirement: Data survives canister upgrades using stable storage patterns (stable vars and preupgrade/postupgrade or equivalent).
missing_requirements.reason: The added backend actor shows in-memory Maps and a mutable counter but no visible stable storage declarations or upgrade hooks in the provided truncated content, so persistence across upgrades is not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Each generation record includes a real createdAt timestamp.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend sets createdAt to recordId.toInt(), which is not a timestamp and will not reflect real creation time.

missing_requirements.requirement: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated (logo, hero illustration, tool icons).
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend references files under /assets/generated, but the diff summary does not include the actual image files/paths under frontend/public/assets/generated (likely omitted as non-text/binary). Presence cannot be verified from the provided diff.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin/access-control initialization and secret-token based authorization bootstrap (including caffeineAdminToken URL parameter usage).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not ask for admin roles, access control frameworks, or secret-token initialization; it only required II sign-in and per-user record isolation.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile collection and mandatory profile setup dialog requesting a name.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not request user profiles or name capture; only basic accounts and per-user generation history were required.

hallucinated_features.description: Footer contains an outbound promotional link to caffeine.ai with UTM parameters.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not request third-party promotional links or attribution in the footer.

hallucinated_features.description: IndexedDB local asset store for generated blobs (separate from backend metadata history).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest required backend persistence of generation metadata; it did not request an additional client-side IndexedDB asset store mechanism.
BuildRequest only required methods to create and list records; deletion was not requested.
